C. Quadropole
D. Time-of-flight

Thought: To determine which mass analyzer is best in terms of resolution, I need to understand the capabilities of each option. Fourier-transform ion cyclotron resonance (FTICR) is known for its very high resolution due to its ability to trap ions and measure their cyclotron frequencies. The Orbitrap also provides high resolution but generally not as high as FTICR. Quadrupole mass analyzers are typically used for lower resolution applications and are valued for their sensitivity and speed rather than resolution. Time-of-flight (TOF) analyzers can achieve moderate to high resolution, but typically not as high as FTICR.

Based on this information, the Fourier-transform ion cyclotron resonance (FTICR) is considered the best in terms of resolution among the given options.
Final Answer: [ANSWER]A[/ANSWER]
